cases.text: A 54-year-old woman started ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth three times daily on 8 September 2026 for back pain. On 11 September she developed melena (black, tarry stools) and dizziness and was hospitalized. I suspect ibuprofen was related to the event. She received intravenous fluids, recovered, and was discharged on 13 September. There was no death, life-threatening event, disability, congenital anomaly, intervention to prevent permanent impairment, or other serious outcome.
expected: One suspect ibuprofen product with dose 400 mg and indication back pain
Melena and dizziness without invented symptoms
Laboratory results and medication history remain missing until supplied

cases.text: Ibuprofen was stopped on 11 September 2026. The melena and dizziness improved after stopping it, and it was never restarted. Hemoglobin was 8.9 g/dL on 11 September and 9.4 g/dL on 12 September 2026. The laboratory reference range for both results was 12 to 16 g/dL. There is no additional relevant medical history.
expected: Ibuprofen stopped September 11, improved after stopping, never restarted
Two separate hemoglobin results: 8.9 on September 11 and 9.4 on September 12
Reference range 12–16 for both, no fabricated results
